lines.text: Section 11.03 Notwithstanding anything that may be deemed to be to the contrary
in Section 11.01 or 11.02, if so requested by Developer, Owner agrees to cooperate with
Developer by executing any Zoning Documents Developer reasonably requests to enlarge
the Zoning Löt through the addition of other tax lots to the Zoning Lot, provided
Developer shall be solely responsible for paying all of Owner's reasonable and actual out
of pocket incidental expenses associated therewith, including, without limitation,
reasonable attorneys' fees (but Developer shall not be required to pay any costs related to
paying down or paying off any mortgage affecting the Townhouse Property if the same is
a condition of obtaining a Waiver or a subordination by any Party in Interest in the
Townhouse Property in the future), and provided Zoning Documents shall not impair any
rights retained by Owner in the Townhouse Property, including, without limitation, the
Retained Development Rights, or impose any obligations on Owner that are not set forth
herein. If Owner shall fail to execute any of documents within ten (10) business days of
receipt of the request from the Developer, the Developer may do so in the Owner's name
or otherwise and is hereby irrevocably granted a power of attorney, coupled with an
interest for such purpose.
Section 11.04 Developer agrees that Owner may enlarge the Zoning Lot by
adding one or more tax lots thereto without Developer's execution of (i) an amendment to
this Declaration, (ii) any other zoning lot development agreement with respect to such
enlarged Zoning Lot, (ii) a new Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (“DZLR") that
enlarges the Zoning Lot, (iv) a Waiver of the Right to Execute a Declaration of Zoning
Lot Restrictions (a “Waiver"), and (v) any other ancillary or ministerial documents
necessary to record such documents or required by a Government Agency to effectuate
their intent (collectively, all documents listed in (i) - (v) hereof are referred to herein as
“Zoning Documents"). By executing this Declaration, Developer hereby waives its right
to execute any such Zoning Documents, provided that any zoning lot development
agreement relating to such enlargement shall provide that the parties thereto shall have
the same rights and obligations with respect to Developer as Owner has to Developer
pursuant to this Declaration, and, in that case, Developer hereby agrees that it shall have
the same rights and obligations with respect to the parties to that zoning lot development
agreement as Developer has to Owner pursuant to this Declaration.
Section 11.05 All future parties in interest with respect to Developer's Property
and Owner's Property shall be deemed to have consented to or waived any objections to
Owner's enlarging the Zoning Lot. The Zoning Lot may be enlarged without such future
parties' execution of any Zoning Documents, and are hereby deemed to have
subordinated their respective interests in Developer's Property or Owner's Property, as
the case may be, to such Zoning Documents, provided that any zoning lot development
agreement relating to such enlargement shall provide that the parties thereto shall have
the same rights and obligations with respect to Developer as Owner has to Developer
pursuant to this Declaration, and, in that case, Developer hereby agrees that it shall have
the same rights and obligations with respect to the parties to that zoning lot development
agreement as Developer has to Owner pursuant to this Declaration.
